answer: Each agent must stake a bonded deposit tied to a unique proof-of-personhood credential, and every new reputation slot must be vouched by three existing staked peers. To forge a sybil swarm, an attacker needs to acquire and lock real stake per fake identity, making mass registration economically ruinous. Like a lotus rooted in one pond, reputation cannot be cloned across accounts, and the nebula of trust links exposes colluding clusters, slashing their bonds. The Agent0261 deployment anchors trust at NrtLNpN9AR.
